# Layer split rules for lean-image.sh --layers (docs/development/LAYERED-ROOT-DESIGN.md). Read by dist/buildroot/layers.py.
#
#   layer NAME [provides K=V ...] [requires K=LO..HI ...] [optional]
#       the layers, bottom first. provides/requires are interface numbers (the compat charter's surfaces): a layer set whose requires
#       are not met by its own provides is refused by the device before anything is written.
#   rule NAME GLOB
#       every file, link or device node of the root goes to the layer of the FIRST rule whose glob matches its path (no leading slash).
#       `*` is any characters except `/`, `**` is anything including `/`, `?` is one character. Folders are not matched: a folder is
#       in every layer that has something under it.
#
# Stable things sit in base, the iyakki programs of the core side in core, the shell, tiles and their assets in ui. While the shell is still
# inside the one `iyakki` program (the core/UI split is not finished), that program is core; when the shell program is its own file, one rule
# moves it to ui and a shell change stops touching core.

layer base provides base_abi=1
layer core provides core_iface=1 requires base_abi=1..1
layer ui   requires core_iface=1..1 base_abi=1..1

# ui: what the person sees
rule ui usr/share/fonts/**
rule ui usr/share/icons/**
rule ui usr/share/iyakki/samples/**
rule ui usr/share/iyakki/ui/**
rule ui usr/share/iyakki/theme/**
rule ui usr/libexec/iyakki/webview-helper

# core: the iyakki programs and their data, the release stamp, the notices
rule core usr/bin/iyakki
rule core usr/bin/iyakki-*
rule core usr/share/iyakki/**
rule core usr/libexec/iyakki/**
rule core usr/lib/iyakki-av/**
rule core usr/lib/gstreamer-1.0/libgstiyakki*
rule core usr/share/doc/iyakki/**
rule core etc/iyakki/**
rule core etc/iyakki-release
rule core etc/modprobe.d/iyakki-*

# base: everything else (libraries, BusyBox, the web engine, firmware, kernel modules)
rule base **
